# Coach's Eye Bowling Lab

> Professional bowling coaching, biomechanical video analysis, and 3-6-9 spare mastery based at Bowlero West Covina in Southern California.

## Coaching Specializations




1. **Biomechanical Video Analysis**: 240fps slow-motion capture evaluating pushaway hinge angle, torso tilt at the foul line, slide knee flexion, and flat spot release window.
2. **1-Handed & 2-Handed Mechanics**: Custom power leverage, axis tilt, and rev-rate-to-speed calibration for traditional and modern two-handed styles.
3. **3-6-9 Systematic Spare Math**: Mathematical stance and target shifts for single pins (Pin 10, 7, 4, 6, 2, 3, 8, 9, 1, 5) with plastic vs urethane strategy.
4. **Oil Pattern & Transition Strategy**: Managing Typical House Shots (41ft THS) and PBA Sport Patterns (39ft) across Game 1 (Fresh), Game 3 (Transition), and Game 5 (Burn & Friction).

## Packages & Pricing
- **Single Tune-Up Lesson**: $65 for 60 minutes (Lane fees included, 240fps video review, custom drills).
- **5-Session Development Blueprint**: $275 for five 60-minute sessions ($55/session — Save $50).
- **4-Week Group Clinic (2–6 Bowlers)**: Tiered pricing ($180/pp for 1-2 bowlers @ 90 min/wk; $170/pp for 3-4 bowlers @ 105 min/wk; $160/pp for 5 bowlers @ 120 min/wk; $150/pp for 6 bowlers @ 120 min/wk).

## How to Book
Students complete a free preliminary diagnostic assessment at https://cebowlinglab.com/#booking to calibrate equipment and baseline averages before on-lane sessions.
